# `date_part`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Extracts a part of the date/timestamp or interval source.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
date_part(field, source)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- date_part, example 1
> SELECT date_part('YEAR', TIMESTAMP '2019-08-12 01:00:00.123456');
2019
```

```sql
-- date_part, example 2
> SELECT date_part('week', timestamp'2019-08-12 01:00:00.123456');
33
```

```sql
-- date_part, example 3
> SELECT date_part('doy', DATE'2019-08-12');
224
```

```sql
-- date_part, example 4
> SELECT date_part('SECONDS', timestamp'2019-10-01 00:00:01.000001');
1.000001
```

```sql
-- date_part, example 5
> SELECT date_part('days', interval 5 days 3 hours 7 minutes);
5
```

```sql
-- date_part, example 6
> SELECT date_part('seconds', interval 5 hours 30 seconds 1 milliseconds 1 microseconds);
30.001001
```

```sql
-- date_part, example 7
> SELECT date_part('MONTH', INTERVAL '2021-11' YEAR TO MONTH);
11
```

```sql
-- date_part, example 8
> SELECT date_part('MINUTE', INTERVAL '123 23:55:59.002001' DAY TO SECOND);
55
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
